title.narrative: UNDP EIA i Ukraina - Förberedande stöd till det nationella registret
UNDP EIA in Ukraine – Preparatory support to the National Registry - EIA in Ukraine – Preparatory support to the National Registry

description.narrative: Projektets syfte är att bistå Ukrainas regering (Ministeriet för ekologi och naturresurser) i implementeringen av lagen om miljökonsekvensanalys. I ett första steg kommer projektet, som implementeras av UNDP, att utveckla ett fungerande elektroniskt Unified National Environmental Impact Assessment Register (ett register över alla inkomna ansökningar till myndigheter där någon sorts miljöprövning är nödvändig) i enlighet med relevant EU-standard. Registret kommer att skräddarsys för den ukrainska kontexten. Detta projekt kommer att ligga till grund för den fortsatta implementeringen av lagen som innefattar kapacitetsutveckling av de centrala och lokala myndigheterna, utbildningar för intressenter i enlighet med deras roll i systemet etc.

The project purpose is to assist the Government of Ukraine (Ministry of Ecology and Natural Resources) in the process of the Environmental Impact Assessment Law implementation. At the first stage, the project, implemented by the UNDP, will develop a well-functioning electronic Unified National Environmental Impact Assessment Registry in accordance with the appropriate EU standards and tailored to the context in Ukraine. This project will also lay the groundwork for the further implementation of the Law that will include capacity building of the central and local authorities, trainings for stakeholders in accordance with their role in the system etc.

The project objective is to develop a well-functioning Unified National Environmental Impact Assessment Registry fully consistent with the appropriate EU standards and tailored to the context in Ukraine. The purpose of the Registry is to enable the transparent process of the conducting the EIA for a new project. It records and makes publicly available online the assessment of a potential project’s effects for the environment and human health, and records decisions and measures aimed at preventing, avoiding, reducing, eliminating significant negative environmental impacts of the planned activity. The Registry aims to contain open documentation for business and the public at all stages of the EIA procedure, which reduces corruption factors in decision making. A key result of the project is the provision of software for launching a fully functional web-based Registry to the Ministry of Ecology, as well as technical assistance and communication support to the first cases entered in to the Registry.
